aiEnrichment.summary_short: In this chilling psychological thriller, a family moves into a remote estate hoping for a fresh start, only to discover an eerie, antique doll hidden away. Soon, unexplainable horrors and terrifying supernatural events begin to plague their daily lives. As the psychological strain deepens, tension mounts between reality and paranoia, forcing them to confront the sinister entity before it destroys them all.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: The story follows a grieving family seeking solace in an isolated countryside home, unaware of the dark history embedded within its walls. Shortly after settling in, they stumble upon a strange, life-like doll tucked away in the attic. Almost immediately, unsettling phenomena begin to disturb their peace, starting with strange noises in the dead of night and objects moving on their own. As the malevolent presence grows stronger, the family members begin experiencing vivid, horrifying hallucinations that turn them against one another. Paranoid and desperate, the protagonist investigates the history of the house, discovering a tragic past involving a cursed artifact meant to trap vengeful spirits. Trapped inside as a fierce storm cuts off all communication, the family must race against time to unravel the mystery behind the doll. Each step closer to the truth reveals horrifying secrets about their own past, threatening to shatter their sanity. In a heart-pounding climax, they must face the vengeful spirit animating the doll to break the curse before they succumb to the overwhelming darkness.
